title: Program page
description: One landscape or certification-path page on astrona.io. The file name (without .yaml) is the page's slug and URL. List order is the order on the page.

slug.description: Optional; must equal the file name when set.

status.description: draft pages are not shown on the site.

sort_order.description: Order among pages of the same kind (menus, footer).

highlights.description: Short cards above the entries. Matched across syncs by title.

entries.description: The cards: certifications on a path, projects on a landscape. Matched across syncs by key, else short_name, else name.

key.description: Set this before renaming an entry, or the rename becomes a delete plus a create.

href.description: Where the card links. Omit for a card without a link.

status.description: upcoming renders as 'Upcoming' instead of a link.

is_active.description: false hides the card on the site.
